title: Assemble RAG context from scored candidates within a token budget
narrative: After retrieval, Fangore asks a decision model for relevance, trust, and freshness scores, then packs only candidates that clear product thresholds into a fixed token budget. Stale, untrusted, or injection-tainted snippets stay out even if they look relevant. When scores are missing, deterministic ranking still fills what it can. Related: `fangore_decision_plane_projection`, `fangore_insp_context_provider`.[^jev-us05]
implementation: `assemble_context_within_budget` in `mechaharness.decision_plane_runtime` packs scored candidates under host thresholds. Judge scores are evidence only; budget and min trust/freshness/relevance are code-owned (DP-04). Agentic Recipe `decision_plane` supplies the typed score batch pattern.
validation: Kind `context_budget_judgment`. Soft expects: high-trust pack within budget; stale and low-trust skipped; injection candidate excluded; missing scores fall back without exceeding budget.
